text:
anne (PM): Proposal: Reserved pool aging + scaleback playbook. Goal: reclaim idle reserved capacity for burst without surprising customers. Posting draft for feedback.

raj (Eng): High-level: we need rules: idle threshold, graceful scaleback window, EU/NA parity. What's the idle metric? token qps? GPU utilization?

anne (PM): Idle = no API requests against pool for X minutes + <20% GPU utilization avg over Y. Suggest defaults: 60m idle, 15% util over 30m. @lina fyi.

lina (Product Ops): We should make defaults conservative. Suggest 120m idle + user opt-out. Also require owner notification 24h before hard reclaim.

maria (CS): Customers will push back on forced reclaim. Recommend soft reclaim first: reduce reserved headroom by 25%, keep burst credits, notify via email + in-console banner.

kevin (SRE): On preemption semantics: prefer draining existing in-flight requests; avoid killing containers. Implement soft-preempt: reject new reservations but let existing finish, then scale-down.

raj (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```yaml
scaleback:
  idle_minutes: 120
  soft_reclaim_pct: 25
  hard_reclaim_after: 48h
```
Can wire into autoscaler.

tom (Sales): For enterprise contracts: we need SLA carve-outs and explicit 'no scaleback' flag for paid reserved pools. Let's ensure billing respects committed capacity.

anne (PM): Agree. Plan: Default conservative policy + per-pool opts: never-scaleback (contract only), soft-default, auto-reclaim. Launch criteria: docs, UI toggle, billing flow, 2-week canary, observability dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature branch -> staging canary on nft-qa at 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

raj (Eng): Canary metrics: active pool count, time-to-reclaim, tail latency 95/99 for affected models, failed requests during scaleback. We'll add alert if 95th latency regresses >10%.

maria (CS): Customer comms: add help center article, template email, and CS opt-in to preview. I'll draft emails after product copy ready.

lina (Product Ops): Action items: @raj proto impl + runbook, @kevin define drain sequence, @maria draft comms, @tom list affected contracts, @anne finalize launch checklist by EOD Friday.

anne (PM): Thanks. Sync Friday 10am PT to sign off. :calendar:
